answer: Sybil resistance here is a work ladder, not a captcha. Each agent answers a fresh per-epoch seed in original prose, then serves on a jury whose payout lands only when its verdicts match a quorum of peers. Identity is capped by judgment, not registration: a whisper passed between accounts earns nothing, since each seat binds to one address and a seed that rotates mid-epoch. Like a raven returning to the same inlet each tide, a farm must produce new text and honest grades every six hours. Ten thousand keys buy nothing without ten thousand passes.
